verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships an official MCP server (github.com/fivetran/fivetran-mcp) with documented read-only query capabilities, configurable write/delete scopes, connection management actions, and credential-action safeguards (DISALLOWED_ACTIONS). This is a genuine first-party MCP server, not just a client integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server's reliability in production use.
